idea-plugin.name: Aero Agent Skills
idea-plugin.description:
Aero Agent Skills — the aerospace knowledge layer for AI agents.

Standards-mapped skills (ECSS · DO-178C · NASA · ARP4754A) that give your AI assistant the certification process — not just the acronyms. 330+ verified skills, each a checked workflow: steps, pitfalls, gates, human sign-off.

  • Skill catalog browser (search any of 330+ skills in the IDE)
  • One-click MCP registration for JetBrains AI Assistant / Junie
  • Agent Skills external-registry link (install skills via the Skills Manager)

Apache-2.0 · github.com/ashfordeOU/aero-agent-skills
